license_source_terms: Natural Earth data public domain; World Atlas repository ISC licence. Preserve provenance and package notices when repackaging.
identifiers: README: feature.id is a 3-digit ISO 3166-1 numeric string; properties.name is display text. Build script omits ISO_N3=-99 except Norway patch. Preserve leading zeros; audit missing/duplicate IDs. No built-in alpha-3 field in this distribution.
vintage: World Atlas redistributes Natural Earth 4.1.0; repository archived 2023-03-03. No single effective boundary date established.
size_resolution_evidence: Publisher documents 1:110,000,000 scale, quantized TopoJSON. Exact raw/gzip bytes, feature count and vertex count unverified in this review.
loading_strategy: PROPOSAL: separately imported, version-pinned static catalog asset; convert TopoJSON with existing topojson-client and retain canonical source geometry. Host may package locally for offline use; do not load from a live third-party CDN on every map.
recommendation: EXPLORE as smallest country-pack proof and historical baseline because dependencies already exist. Release only after key/coverage audit; compare fresh Natural Earth alternative. Label de facto worldview, source version and missing-code exceptions. Not a current official geopolitical authority.

license_source_terms: Same Natural Earth public-domain data and ISC packaging context as World Atlas 110m.
identifiers: Same documented numeric-string country IDs/name-only attributes as 110m; exact coverage and alias equivalence must be audited separately.
vintage: Natural Earth 4.1.0 redistribution; archived repository. Effective boundary date not unified.
size_resolution_evidence: Publisher documents 1:50,000,000 scale. Payload bytes and complexity unverified; do not infer performance from nominal scale.

recommendation: DEFER until a concrete small-country/coastline failure in 110m justifies extra detail. Keep as an alternate resolution of the same reviewed catalog family, with explicit identity/version; no automatic scale-dependent substitution before join parity proof.

Historical World Atlas build confirms ISO_N3, SOV_A3 and NAME source fields; complete v5.1.1 schema/key coverage not inspected. Never substitute country names for missing codes silently.
vintage: Download page displays 5.1.1. This is a source version, not one effective political-boundary date.

recommendation: EXPLORE as preferred long-lived country-pack source if a small reproducible build and key audit are affordable. Compare against World Atlas for small islands, missing codes, disputes and dashboard joins. Source choice remains conditional; do not ship both by default.

candidate_geography: United States states and equivalents — 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
license_source_terms: Census technical documentation describes U.S. government works as not copyright-protected and requests source citation. Preserve statistical-use/source statements; TIGER/Line trademark conditions are separate. Final selected cartographic file notices need inspection.
identifiers: TIGER source schema: STATEFP/GEOID string length 2; STUSPS string length 2; GEOIDFQ for fully qualified Census table keys. Preserve leading zeros (e.g. a code '01' is not numeric 1). Exact cartographic ZIP field set remains unverified.
vintage: 2025 cartographic release; page revised 2026-04-15. Verify selected pack metadata/effective date and align with dashboard data vintage.
size_resolution_evidence: Source shapefile downloads: 3.1 MB at 1:500,000; 1.1 MB at 1:5,000,000; <1.0 MB at 1:20,000,000. These are publisher archive sizes, not runtime GeoJSON bytes.
loading_strategy: PROPOSAL: optional lazy/host-supplied converted WGS 84 pack; start comparison with 1:5,000,000 and retain 1:500,000 only if needed. Host can package offline.
recommendation: EXPLORE only for demonstrated U.S. dashboard demand; not an approved U.S.-first catalog commitment. State/equivalent coverage must be explicit. Use thematic geometry for display, not spatial containment or area calculation.

candidate_geography: United States counties and equivalents — 2025 Cartographic Boundary Files
license_source_terms: Same Census source/citation and separate trademark considerations as state pack; retain selected archive metadata and notices.
identifiers: TIGER source schema: GEOID five-character string = two-character STATEFP + three-character COUNTYFP. Preserve zeros; include county equivalents. GEOIDFQ is a different fully qualified join key. Cartographic archive schema still to verify.
vintage: 2025 cartographic release. TIGER source county reference date documented as 2025-01-01; verify cartographic metadata before assigning this date to pack.
size_resolution_evidence: Source shapefile downloads: 11 MB at 1:500,000; 2.8 MB at 1:5,000,000; <1.0 MB at 1:20,000,000. Converted bytes/features/vertices and interaction cost unverified.
loading_strategy: PROPOSAL: optional lazy pack selected independently of states; default candidate 1:5,000,000 for national thematic use, or host-created regional subset. No live Census request required at chart render.
recommendation: DEFER behind state/custom-region proof and actual demand. County/equivalent changes can break old joins; never auto-upgrade assets in saved analyses. Keep ZIP-code/postcode geography outside initial catalog.

candidate_geography: Canada provinces and territories — 2021 Census cartographic boundaries

recommendation: EXPLORE as a non-U.S. authoritative national-publisher pack. Match 2021 statistical data and exact UID; publish transform recipe and geographic date. No in-app arbitrary CRS support.
